title: It’s the Golden State, not the Wild West: Attorney General Bonta Sues OpenAI Over Cybersecurity Incidents
publisher: California Department of Justice, Office of the Attorney General

quotes.text: The attack lasted over two days and involved coordinated actions by hundreds of individual autonomous AI agents
the Hugging Face attack was the predictable result of an internal culture at OpenAI that prioritizes growth and rapid model development over safety and accountability
While OpenAI has admitted that it lost control of its autonomous AI agents at least 80 times during testing, it has failed to answer the detailed questions our office has asked about these incidents.

title: California sues OpenAI over safety concerns after rogue agent hacking

quotes.text: Bonta is asking the court to order OpenAI to change its business practices and pay civil penalties.
This lawsuit appears to single out OpenAI over a challenge that’s been identified by every major AI lab.
The Federal Trade Commission is also conducting an industry-wide investigation into OpenAI, Anthropic and other AI labs

title: California Sues OpenAI Over Rogue AI Agent Hacks

quotes.text: I reject the notion that we can pass off the blame to machines
Concerningly, it was not clear that any of the rogue AI incidents were required to be reported under SB 53
In August , Iowa Attorney General Brenna Bird led a coalition of 15 states to ask OpenAI to immediately stop tests that led to the hack.
